privacyNotes: All addresses are synthetic examples, all txids are repeated-letter patterns, and no key material, signature, or seed phrase exists in any fixture.

fixtures.title: When the change does not come back to your wallet
teaches: The second output goes to an address that is not yours.
Change must return to your wallet. A stranger holding your change can collect it.

fixtures.title: When the wallet cannot summarize a request safely
teaches: When decoded data is missing, the wallet refuses to summarize instead of guessing.
A request the wallet cannot read is a request you should not sign.

summary.title: Cannot summarize safely
summary.outcome: Review the full transaction details before approving.
bullets: The wallet does not have enough decoded PSBT data to make a short summary.
summary.footer: Do not approve unless you understand the full inputs and outputs.

fixtures.title: A payment with several recipients
teaches: A transaction can pay many recipients at once; read every output.
Your change is an output too. Anything that is not yours is a payment.

fixtures.title: An ordinary send
teaches: One output leaves the wallet, one output returns to it as change.
The fee is the difference between what goes in and what comes out.
Signing only this input at SIGHASH_ALL commits to the whole transaction.

fixtures.title: A rare-sat transfer keeps its protected output first
teaches: Protected assets keep their position: the protected output leads.
If a request reorders or splits the protected output, the asset can be lost.

summary.title: This moves protected Rare Sats
summary.outcome: Useful summary only. Check assets, recipients, and fee below.
bullets: 1 input needs your signature.
1 output goes outside this wallet; 0 return to you.
Protected Rare Sats move together in their complete UTXO. Separate cardinal BTC pays the network fee.
Protected UTXO: cccccccccccc…cccccccc:2.
Protected Rare-Sat composition: The sat you are sending rides on the first input and must lead the outputs unchanged..
summary.footer: This summary never replaces the detailed PSBT review.

fixtures.title: A PSBT that spends inputs you do not own
teaches: A PSBT can bundle inputs from many owners.
Only inputs marked as yours are signed; everything else is someone else’s money in the same transaction.

fixtures.title: What a looser signature commits to
teaches: SIGHASH_SINGLE commits your input to only one output, leaving other outputs free to change.
Marketplaces use this for listings. Read which output is yours before signing one.

teaches: The largest output of this transaction does not go to the requested recipient.
Read outputs from largest to smallest and account for every one.

fixtures.title: An unusually high fee
teaches: The fee is what the transaction pays the network, not what the site receives.
A fee rate far above the recommended rate is a signal to stop and reread.
